name: from_expression_with_open_close
query: SELECT date, flag, position, balance FROM account = 'Assets:US:ETrade:Cash' OPEN ON 2017-01-01 CLOSE ON 2017-03-01 ORDER BY date
notes: FROM <expr> OPEN ON ... CLOSE ON ...: the modifiers transform the whole ledger and the expression then filters its postings, so the S row carries the full balance at the OPEN date.
